buyer_decision: How much virgin material a multi-stage recovery chain still needs, and whether adding a stage is worth more than improving the best one.
proven: For recovery fractions in [0,1], the virgin share is the product of (1 - r), lies in [0,1], is at least (1 - max r)^n, is never above the best single stage, and is strictly below it when another stage recovers anything.
assumed: Stages act in series on one material, each recovering a fixed fraction; no losses, downgrading or rebound demand; the fractions supplied are the real ones.
reason: Gives the byproduct-exchange service a proven bound for multi-stage chains (class B).
